debug_info.intent_user: Membuat dashboard piutang customer dari invoice penjualan yang belum lunas, mencakup daftar invoice outstanding, ringkasan outstanding per customer beserta aging bucket, dan ranking customer dengan risiko keterlambatan tertinggi.
debug_info.reasoning: 1) Entitas utama yang paling tepat adalah header invoice penjualan m5_si karena user meminta piutang customer, daftar invoice, status lunas, jatuh tempo, dan outstanding per customer. Sesuai pedoman, 'penjualan' default berarti invoice penjualan. 2) Untuk informasi customer digunakan m1_contact melalui relasi m5_si.sicustomer = m1_contact.kid. Tabel ini juga punya always_apply_filters kaktif = 1 yang wajib diterapkan. 3) Karena user meminta invoice belum lunas, dipakai filter invoice yang outstanding-nya masih ada, dihitung dari selisih sitotaltransaksi - sijmlbayar, serta tambahan status lunas belum/sebagian bila tersedia untuk memperkuat semantik. 4) Karena m5_si punya always_apply_filters siisclose = 0, filter ini wajib diterapkan di semua query. 5) Aging bucket dihitung dari DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), sitgljatuhtempo) agar kompatibel dengan MySQL/MariaDB dan menghasilkan pengelompokan overdue/current. 6) Risiko keterlambatan tertinggi ditafsirkan sebagai customer dengan kombinasi overdue amount terbesar dan invoice overdue terbanyak; maka query ranking mengagregasi outstanding overdue, jumlah invoice overdue, dan hari overdue maksimum. 7) Permintaan dashboard cukup luas, jadi dipakai 3 query yang saling melengkapi tanpa duplikasi: invoice listing, summary aging per customer, dan ranking risiko keterlambatan.

linting_warnings: Query dashboard menggunakan fungsi DATEDIFF dan CURDATE sehingga hasil aging bersifat dinamis mengikuti tanggal saat eksekusi.
Query listing invoice tidak memakai LIMIT karena dimaksudkan untuk dashboard operasional; jika data sangat besar bisa berdampak full scan/hasil besar.

queries.name: Daftar Invoice Belum Lunas
queries.purpose: Menampilkan daftar invoice customer yang masih outstanding berikut umur piutang dan bucket aging.
queries.query: SELECT si.siid AS invoice_id, si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.simatauang AS mata_uang, si.sitotaltransaksi AS total_invoice, si.sijmlbayar AS total_terbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS outstanding, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) AS hari_jatuh_tempo, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa JT' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN 'Belum JT' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '>90' END AS aging_bucket, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 AND (si.sistatuslunas IS NULL OR si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS') ORDER BY outstanding DESC, si.sitgl ASC

queries.name: Outstanding dan Aging per Customer
queries.purpose: Merangkum total outstanding per customer dan distribusi aging bucket untuk dashboard piutang.
queries.query: SELECT c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice_belum_lunas, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) < 0 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_belum_jt, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_0_30, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_31_60, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_61_90, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 90 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_gt_90 FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 AND (si.sistatuslunas IS NULL OR si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS') GROUP BY c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC

queries.name: Customer Risiko Keterlambatan Tertinggi
queries.purpose: Merangking customer dengan risiko keterlambatan tertinggi berdasarkan overdue outstanding, jumlah invoice overdue, dan maksimum hari overdue.
queries.query: SELECT c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN si.siid END) AS jumlah_invoice_overdue, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS total_overdue_outstanding, MAX(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE NULL END) AS hari_overdue_tertinggi, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 AND (si.sistatuslunas IS NULL OR si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS') GROUP BY c.kkode, c.knama HAVING total_overdue_outstanding > 0 ORDER BY total_overdue_outstanding DESC, jumlah_invoice_overdue DESC, hari_overdue_tertinggi DESC LIMIT 100
